rationale: Pin orchestrate 0.10.0 (680f96d, tag v0.10.0). Upstream changes since d438044: the claude routing tiers implement one level lower (tier 2 sonnet at high, tier 3 opus at medium) and name a review_effort that keeps reviewers at xhigh and high, read by plan.py's new _lens for the conformance lens, the tie-break and a moved adversary, with evidence in evals/results/2026-11-10-tier-efforts.md; the orchestrator skill inherits the session's model and references/harness-claude.md says to stop on a session below the tier 3 model, to keep exploration on a small model and that an unset effort on another model runs at an undocumented level; a top rung above tier 3 is named; run_workflow.js reads the process table with a larger buffer; the version moves to 0.10.0 including the loop's SCRIPT_VERSION. Saved copies of the loop must be refreshed (README, host-execution).
